prompt: Let's set a family password. If anyone calls asking for money urgently, we ask for this word.

muc.title: A call in the middle of the night
muc.text: Late at night, your child calls, panicking, asking you to send money fast. But it might not be your child.

muc.title: What is a deepfake?
muc.text: AI can now copy a person's voice and face. This is called a deepfake.

muc.title: A few seconds of voice is enough
muc.text: Scammers only need a few seconds of your voice from a clip you posted online to make new sentences in that same voice. Video calls can have a swapped face too.

muc.title: Signs to be suspicious
muc.text: Common signs: they rush you, ask for money or a one-time code (OTP), and try to stop you from checking.

muc.title: Hang up and call back yourself
muc.text: The simplest way: hang up, and call that person back on the number you know.

muc.title: A family password
muc.text: The second way: your family agrees on a password only family members know. If a strange call asks for money, ask for that password.

muc.title: Set a family password tonight
muc.text: Tonight, message your family group and agree on a shared password. It takes one minute, but it could keep your whole family from losing money.
